overall: Board did not violate the OML at its Nov. 23 and Dec. 1, 2009 meetings, but its Review Team violated it by failing to post notice for interview meetings; no remedy because the violation predated July 1, 2010.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged two selectmen's Nov. 23 and Dec. 1, 2009 meetings with Fire Department staff were unposted, closed subcommittee meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by sending two representatives to meet with members of the Fire Department on November 23, 2009 and December 1, 2009.

allegations.summary: The Review Team held investigative interview meetings in Sept.-Oct. 2009 without posting notice; the Board called the omission a clerical oversight.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's Review Team did violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice for its interview meetings.
